title: Chapter 53
text: a paper star splattered with gold paint The Starless Sea is rising. The owls watch as the tides shift, slowly at first. They fly over waves that break upon long-abandoned shores. They call out warnings and exaltations. The time has come. They have waited so long. They screech and celebrate until the sea is so high that they too must seek shelter. The Starless Sea continues to rise. Now it floods the Harbor, pulling the books from their shelves and claiming the Heart for itself. The end has come. Here now is the Owl King bringing the future on his wings.
